copper mountain.note: Happy Thanksgiving! We sure are thankful for colder temps this week as a storm is expected to roll in this weekend. No new snow to report this morning. For Thanksgiving, we can expect sunny skies with temps in the mid-30s at mid-mountain. Winds will be out of the WNW ranging from 5 to 10 mph and gusting into the 20's. Yesterday the Pitchfork lift and the Green Acres Beginner Area opened for the season, expanding our early season beginner terrain offerings. We'll have more terrain announcements to share later this week. Keep an eye on our Terrain Updates channel on Instagram to stay locked in with the latest information. We're now just a few days out from the Stifel Copper Cup, bringing the fastest men in the world to the slopes of East Village. For the full weekend event schedule visit: https://www.coppercolorado.com/copper-cup/event-experience/ . A friendly reminder that early-season conditions are still in play. Ski and ride in control, stay aware of changing surfaces and conditions, and give each other plenty of space. We've got a long season to look forward to still, and we're all in this together. Happy Turkey Day to those who celebrate!

eldora.note: 5:39 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, 2026. We've got so much to be grateful for—our devoted mountain crews who have worked so hard to get the mountain open and continue to crush, around the clock, to open more terrain; our amazing mountain and the beautiful natural environment we call home; and you, our devoted guests who make the Eldora community so special. Thank you! Yesterday, our teams opened two more trails, Windmill and Klondike, bringing the total to two complete top-to-bottom runs, plus an amazing Woodward terrain park in the base area. What better way to kick off Thanksgiving Day with family and friends than to come spin a few laps at your backyard mountain? Grab a ride up on the RTD—it's time for Turkey Turns! 🦃 🏔️ NWS Weather Snapshot: Partly sunny, then gradually becoming sunny, with a high near 41. Breezy, with a west wind of 13 to 18 mph. Safety: No trees or glades will be open. Expect thin, early-season conditions on Opening Day and beyond. Be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly on Opening Day and all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes. Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates. Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here . Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions , for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply). ELDORA for general alerts UPHILL for uphill-specific updates NORDIC for Nordic updates. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week . Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com .

snowbird.note: Happy Thanksgiving! Resort Update: The Aerial Tram, Little Cloud, Gadzoom, Wilbere and Chickadee are scheduled to start spinning at 9 a.m., conditions permitting. All uphill travel is closed and early-season conditions exist. Please be aware of objects at or below the snow surface. Mountain Report: Whether you're sitting down to Thanksgiving dinner or joining us on the slopes, there are four magic words today... GIVE ME THE BIRD! On this Turkey Day, boy oh boy am I grateful we're out skiing again! Opening Day was phenomenal and the mountain is skiing great and, spoiler alert, more of the same is in store for today. Expect a mix of sunshine and clouds with upper-mountain temps in the 30s. It could be a little windy at the top with gusts near 30mph, so it might be a good day for a buff or extra layer before you've built up your mid-winter cold tolerance. Our Tramsgiving event is from 12 to 3:45p, bring 3 non-perishable canned goods in exchange for one free scenic ride up the tram! All proceeds will benefit the Utah Food Bank. Great cause. Great views. What could be better? Snowbird Tramsgiving It’s early season, so take it easy out there. Ski and ride in control, respect closures and rope lines, and remember that lift and terrain availability can change throughout the day. Give me The Bird.
